changelog: Initial release: Bitwarden password manager CLI (bw) with email/password, API key, and SSO authentication. Supports self-hosted Bitwarden/Vaultwarden. tmux session workflow for secure session key management.
summary: Set up and use Bitwarden CLI (bw). Use when installing the CLI, authenticating (login/unlock), or reading secrets from your vault. Supports email/password, API key, and SSO authentication methods.
